_comment: Weight overrides by rule id (defaults live in handicapper/rules.py). Empty = defaults. 'disabled' lists rule ids to switch off.

probability._comment: The one win-probability model (handicapper/probability.py): softmax of the ability score blended with the morning line; elim_floor applies to Pick 3/4 pricing only.

timing._comment: Per-race wagering cutoff (handicapper/timing.py): a run counts as pre-race for a race when made this many minutes before its post (or its chart's actual off time).

multirace._comment: Pick 3 / Pick 4 construction (handicapper/multirace.py, rules H1-H10). Budgets in dollars; base = the denomination every ticket is bet at ($1 Pick 3, $0.50 Pick 4); a track menu minimum above it (e.g. $3 Late Pick 3) applies instead.

_tracks_comment: Track profiles layer over the global weights/selection/multirace above and are chosen by the track code the parser reads off the PP (pick.py --track-profile overrides). Every value here is an expert prior, not a fitted weight: fit them per track with backtest.py once enough cards are on file. Each track also carries `timezone` (IANA), `location` (for the optional weather forecast) and `off_turf_surface` (what a turf race taken off the turf is scored on: dirt, or aw for a Tapeta main track).

DMR._comment: Del Mar: speed-favouring main track, course-specialist turf; 5f turf sprints are speed races.

SA._comment: Santa Anita: speed holds on dirt, early pace figures (E2) decide sprints; downhill turf is its own course (D5).

SAR._comment: Saratoga: big fields, late pace and course specialists on turf, lone speed less reliable; trainer % thresholds are circuit-high.

BEL._comment: Belmont: long stretch, late pace matters; two turf courses.

AQU._comment: Aqueduct: inside speed on the main track in winter; smaller fields.

GP._comment: Gulfstream: large turf fields, turf form and late pace; chaos legs are common. $1 'Bet 3', $0.50 Pick 4/5 (per the Power Play sheet wager menu).

KEE._comment: Keeneland: speed-favouring dirt, course specialists; short meet so meet bias tables are thin (P5 lighter).

CD._comment: Churchill Downs: fair main track, long stretch; course specialists on the turf.

wagering._comment: Wagering analysis (handicapper/wagering.py): unit stake per bet type, in dollars, whatever the track's minimum; Pick 3 / Pick 4 tickets are priced at multirace.pick3/pick4.base. Other wagers count as bets placed; Pick 3/4 tickets are tracked but not counted (count_multirace) until they have a record.

tote._comment: PuntersEdge /v1/racing/tote (TVG's US board). One read = every race of the day for 2 credits. daily_credit_cap bounds what the app spends per UTC day; poll: nothing until from_minutes before post, then sparse_every seconds, near_every inside near_minutes, last_every inside last_minutes, stop at off/official. stale_seconds marks an old quote. Key: PUNTERSEDGE_API_KEY or data/private/puntersedge.key (never committed).

pricing._comment: Phase D price formula (handicapper/research.py): a win bet needs O_min = (1 + tau + costs - rebate) / p - 1 with p the engine's heuristic win probability; break-even odds 1/p - 1 are shown beside it. tau 0.15 replaces the old fair odds x 1.15. adverse_drift is a research scenario (the quote shortens by this share). place_show_tau sets the minimum $2 price of a place or show candidate.

research._comment: Research probabilities (handicapper/research.py): p_rule_heuristic (softmax, eliminated starters at research_floor), q_live_market (tote), p_market_anchor ~ q^alpha * exp(beta * z). model_status is UNTRAINED until Phase E validates a model; while it is not VALIDATED every single-horse wager is NO_BET (UNTRAINED_MODEL) in the research layer and exotics are 'candidate, unpriced'. The legacy analysis still counts suggested bets as before.

wager_policy._comment: The owner's decisions table (docs/CAROVEX_V2_PROMPT.md, 2026-11-16; handicapper/policy.py). Each flag suppresses a suggestion and records why on the race.

data_watch._comment: Phase E (handicapper/evaluation.py). Thresholds are the owner's; the code only counts races. floor is the probability floor in the log loss. blend_grid lists the morning-line weights looked at on the early half of the races and reported on the late half (nothing is fitted on the races it is scored on, nothing is written back here).

track_specific.unit: races on one circuit (rules_config.json -> circuits) with a pre-race prediction and a result
track_specific.capability: anything circuit- or track-specific (weights, scale, blend) as shrunken effects under the global model

_circuits_comment: Circuits are the owner's pooling assumption (2026-11-16): tracks that share a horse population, trainer and jockey colonies and condition books are counted together by the data watch's circuit gate and will be the middle level (global -> circuit -> track) of the hierarchical models once the global gate is met. A track not listed is its own circuit. This is a judgement about exchangeability, not a statistical result.
